Data extraction: JSON top-level array emits Sequence nodes

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\TreeSitterLanguagePack;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Language;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Tree;
$config = \Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig::from_json(json_encode(["dataExtraction" => true, "language" => "json"]));
$result = TreeSitterLanguagePack::process("[1, 2, 3]", $config);
var_dump($result->getData());
var_dump($result->getData()->kind);
var_dump($result->getData()->getChildren());
```
